title: Wartime Stories - Videos
description:
WARNING – Many of these stories are NOT suitable for younger audiences.

For all things strange and unusual related to war and the military, Wartime Stories covers the most chilling cases of crimes against humanity, bizarre tales, unsolved mysteries, espionage, deception, creepy encounters of the paranormal, as well as feats of valor and ultimate sacrifice.

[ Wartime Stories is the proud sister channel of Bedtime Stories, hosted by Richard While. ]
